attorneys: Arthur Karger and Henry G. Singer for petitioner. Solicitor General Cox, Assistant Attorney General Miller, Beatrice Rosenberg and Ronald L. Gainer for the United States.. Emil Oxfeld for American Civil Liberties Union of New Jersey, as amicus curiae, in support of the petition.

opinions.text: Motion of American Civil Liberties Union of New Jersey for leave to file a brief, as amicus curiae, granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit denied,
